displayedInputs.question:
What plane figure is formed when the lateral surface of a cylinder is unfolded?

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)
Which of the following is a solid figure?

How many faces does a hexagonal prism have in total? (Include the top and bottom bases.)

[Figure 1](attached-image-10)

A prism has 21 edges in total. How many sides does its base have? (Enter a number; for example, enter 5 for a pentagonal prism.)

[Figure 1](attached-image-11)

How many common forms of a cube's net are there? How many squares does each net contain? (Answer in order, separated by a comma.)

[Figure 1](attached-image-12)

What shapes are obtained when an upright cylinder is viewed from the front and from above, respectively?

[Figure 1](attached-image-13)

A solid is built from small cubes: the bottom layer has 2 rows and 2 columns, totaling 4 small cubes, and the second layer has only 1 small cube placed at one corner. How many small squares can be seen from above?

[Figure 1](attached-image-14)
Which of the following figures made from 6 identical small squares cannot be folded into a cube?

choices.A:
4 squares in a row, with 2 more below, directly adjoining the bottom edges of the 2 leftmost squares in that row (forming a 2-by-2 block)

[Figure 1](attached-image-15)
choices.B:
3 squares in the first row and 3 in the second row, with the leftmost square of the second row directly adjoining the bottom edge of the rightmost square of the first row

[Figure 2](attached-image-16)
choices.C:
3 rows of 2 squares each, with each row shifted one square to the right of the row above it, so that exactly one square in each pair of adjacent rows directly adjoins a square above or below

[Figure 3](attached-image-17)
choices.D:
4 squares in the middle row, with 1 above and 1 below, directly adjoining the top and bottom, respectively, of a small square in the middle row

[Figure 4](attached-image-18)
